title: Conduit Awareness
tagline: Conduit Awareness in Skyrimnet. Prompt plug triggers
description:
SkyrimNet — Conduit Awareness
=============================

Requires Conduit on Nexus

Makes Conduit's short-term weapon infusions visible to SkyrimNet NPCs.

When you force a spell into a held weapon, nearby characters can react to the
live charge (heat, frost, sparks, judgement-light, or raw arcane — from the
active Conduit MainEff). Every Conduit cast is also written into the persistent
event log so dialogue and memory can refer to it later. Optional rare narration
fires so the moment can land cinematically without spamming every cast in combat.

REQUIREMENTS
SkyrimNet
Conduit - Short-term Weapon Infusions (Conduit.esp)

INSTALL
Install as a normal mod (Vortex / MO2) or merge the SKSE folder into Data.
Restart the game (or reload SkyrimNet prompts/triggers).
If you have an older single trigger named conduit_weapon_cast_trigger, disable it.

CONTENTS
character_bio/0196_conduit_weapon.prompt
triggers/conduit_weapon_cast_persistent.yaml (100%)
triggers/conduit_weapon_cast_narration.yaml (20%, 120s)

NOTES
Does not change Conduit gameplay — SkyrimNet files only.
Element flavor comes from the bio prompt (MainEff), not the cast trigger.
Compatible with Spellsiphon Awareness; wording is kept distinct(conducted spell vs siphoned element).
